subject.title: Support session-level environment variables for ACP sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a trusted request-time `sessions_spawn.env` contract for ACP sessions, or should ACP env remain limited to configured agent/runtime and broader per-call env mechanisms?
rationale: The requested API would carry credential-like values into host ACP subprocesses and overlaps with active env-design work, so maintainer product/security intent is needed before implementation.

options.title: Design guarded ACP session env
options.body: Add `sessions_spawn.env` only with explicit trusted-caller rules, blocked-key validation, redaction, precedence, non-persistence or reuse behavior, docs, and focused ACP tests.

options.title: Fold into broader env design
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80329 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93425 explicitly cover ACP session needs before closing or implementing this separately.

options.title: Reject request-time ACP env
options.body: Keep ACP subprocess env controlled by configured runtimes and documented setup paths, and document that per-session credential overrides are intentionally unsupported.

recommendation.title: Design guarded ACP session env
recommendation.body: Add `sessions_spawn.env` only with explicit trusted-caller rules, blocked-key validation, redaction, precedence, non-persistence or reuse behavior, docs, and focused ACP tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current ACP session/spawn surface and are the strongest code-history owner for deciding whether this API belongs in that boundary.
